shortDescription: Dante Trudel's high-intensity bodybuilding system using rest-pause sets, extreme stretching, and 3-exercise rotation to hit each muscle 3 times every 2 weeks.
descriptionHtml: Dante Trudel's high-intensity bodybuilding system using rest-pause sets, extreme stretching, and 3-exercise rotation to hit each muscle 3 times every 2 weeks.
author: Dante Trudel

sections.name: Week 1 — A1: Chest, Shoulders, Triceps, Back
sections.notes: Perform **extreme stretching** (60-90s loaded stretch) for each body part after its working set.
